name: @aethelred/wallet-sovereign-export
description: Regulator-format export templates: FinCEN SAR (form 111), FinCEN CTR (form 112), GDPR DSAR (articles 15/17/20), MiCA transaction reporting. Signed envelopes (EIP-712) so regulators verify the export is produced by an authorised operator. PII redaction with per-report rules. Ships a CLI so compliance ops can run exports without embedding the TS API.
